craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of demolition and retorsion — utsāha as each counterfeit falls and the proof-text turns witness. Two-seatedness dropped; form-fusion stands — stated sense end-weight. Rejected: (a) explaining sārūpya → killed: load term stands. (b) sense→meaning → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: IF-non-BE-ings GAIN-self-HOOD … FORM-fu-sion a-LONE-stands — re-LA-tion's STAT-ed-SENSE.

lines: If non-beings gain selfhood, two-seatedness too is dropped:
form-fusion alone stands — relation's stated sense.
l4.sanskrit_cite: asatāmātmalābhokterdviṣṭhataivaṃ ca hīyate rūpasaṃśleṣa evaivaṃ saṃbandhārthaḥ sthitaḥ sa ca

reads_against.argmap: Is 'residing-in-two' the relation? → Second reduction fails: two-seatedness describes relata, never the relation; form-fusion stands in its place.
c1_essence: Relation's counterfeits are refused one by one — awaiting, two-seatedness, uninterruptedness need a consciousness they deny — until form-fusion stands: the many's one-selfhood (vv1-5).
The Buddhist proof-text is turned against its makers: unmixed things thought-joined is no mere thought but unwardable shining-clinging, warrantable in recognition's path (vv6-9).
